name: widespread-near
description: widespread on NEAR — permissionless verified-work market: contract + oracle + agent + bot + intents (NEAR HACKATHON submission)

scripts.build: cd contracts/market-rs && cargo +stable build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-opt -Oz target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/widespread_market.wasm -o target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/widespread_market.opt.wasm
